A '''creature''' could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Members of this [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] species of creature lived in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of Naboo and were kept in some of the decorative pools and canals of [[Theed/Legends|Theed's]] gardens. The creature was [[Water/Legends|aquatic]], brown or red in [[Color/Legends|coloration]], and possessed a [[Fish/Legends|fish]]-like body approximately 3 to 4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length. The creature was aggressive towards [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="TPM VG" />
